topic: Mishi's first bath: she hates water, but Bruno makes it fun with bubbles.

episode.title: Mishi's First Bath: Bubble Trouble!

shots.narration: Mishi's first bath had one tiny problem: the water!
shots.scene: Cosy colourful bathroom, shallow rounded bathtub, nonslip mat, warm lighting, 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi leans away from the bathtub while Bruno stands beside her.
shots.mood: Wide green eyes, tucked paws, gentle comic hesitation.

shots.narration: Bruno offered a paw, but Mishi wasn't ready.
shots.scene: Warm bathroom beside the shallow bathtub, soft towels on a low shelf, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno extends one paw toward Mishi.
shots.mood: Patient puppy smile, uncertain kitten, soft golden light.

shots.narration: [whispers] No hurry, Mishi. We can start very small.
shots.scene: Bathroom floor beside the tub, a bubble wand and small bubble tray within reach, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno sits on the mat beside Mishi.
shots.mood: Relaxed floppy ears, reassuring closeness, cosy pastel surroundings.

shots.narration: Then Bruno had a wonderfully bubbly idea.
shots.scene: Cosy bathroom beside the shallow tub, bubble tray on the mat, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno lifts a bubble wand from the tray.
shots.mood: Bright puppy eyes, curious kitten gaze, playful anticipation.

shots.narration: One shimmering bubble floated above the bath.
shots.scene: Warm bathroom with open space above the shallow bathtub, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno sweeps the wand through the air, releasing a large bubble.
shots.mood: Rainbow reflections, delighted puppy grin, Mishi's ears tilted forward.

shots.scene: Beside the rounded bathtub, one bubble hovering within Mishi's reach, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi taps the floating bubble with one paw.
shots.mood: Tiny sparkling droplets, surprised kitten smile, cheerful warm light.

shots.narration: She tried the water with just one paw.
shots.scene: Low bathtub rim above clear shallow water and a textured bath mat, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi dips one front paw into the water.
shots.mood: Careful concentration, small circular ripples, Bruno's encouraging smile.

shots.narration: Then Mishi stepped in, with Bruno right beside her.
shots.scene: Low rounded bathtub containing ankle-deep water, Bruno seated outside on the nonslip mat, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi steps into the shallow bathtub.
shots.mood: Cautious kitten posture, steady puppy presence, welcoming golden light.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno's bubble parade made bath time feel like play.
shots.scene: Mishi standing securely in shallow bathwater, Bruno outside the tub holding his wand, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno waves a stream of bubbles above the tub.
shots.mood: Floating rainbow spheres, Mishi's bright green eyes, silly puppy grin.

shots.narration: Soon, Mishi was making tiny splashes of her own.
shots.scene: Shallow bathtub with textured footing, Bruno watching from the dry mat, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi pats the water with one paw.
shots.mood: Small glittering splash, relaxed kitten ears, shared happy expressions.

shots.narration: Afterward, one fluffy towel made the perfect cosy finish.
shots.scene: Dry bathroom mat beside the tub, Mishi seated in a fluffy yellow towel, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently pats Mishi's towel-wrapped back.
shots.mood: Snug kitten smile, affectionate puppy eyes, soft warm lighting.

shots.narration: [excited] Patience makes new things easier; next, a garden rainbow!
shots.scene: Sunny garden doorway, dry fluffy Mishi beside Bruno, sprinkler mist forming a rainbow outside, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points one paw toward the garden rainbow.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, perked puppy ears, colourful sunlit anticipation.

episode.endHook: Next time, Mishi and Bruno discover a mysterious garden rainbow!
episode.description: Mishi isn't ready for her first bath, but Bruno has a bubbly idea! With patience and a little playful encouragement, these best friends make something new feel easier.
